units.source_text: 轮船出了下田海面，我全神贯注地凭栏眺望着海上的大岛，

en.t: After the steamer left the waters off Shimoda, I leaned on the railing and gazed intently at Oshima out at sea,

units.source_text: 直到伊豆半岛的南端，那大岛才渐渐消失在船后。

en.t: and only when we reached the southern tip of the Izu Peninsula did the island gradually disappear behind the boat.

units.source_text: 同舞女离别，仿佛是遥远的过去。

en.t: Parting from the dancing girl already felt like something from the distant past.
What had become of the old woman?

units.source_text: 我窥视船舱，人们围坐在她的身旁，竭力抚慰她。

en.t: I peered into the cabin and saw people sitting around her, doing all they could to comfort her.

units.source_text: 我放下心来，走进了贴邻的船舱。

en.t: Relieved, I went into the adjoining cabin.

units.source_text: 相模湾上，波浪汹涌起伏。

en.t: On Sagami Bay, the waves heaved violently.

units.source_text: 一落座就不时左跌右倒。

en.t: As soon as I sat down, I kept lurching from side to side.

units.source_text: 船员依次分发着金属小盆。

en.t: The crew members were handing out small metal basins one after another.

units.source_text: 我用书包当枕头，躺了下来。

en.t: I used my school bag as a pillow and lay down.

units.source_text: 脑子空空，已全无时间概念。

en.t: My mind was blank, and I had lost all sense of time.

units.source_text: 泪水簌簌地滴落在书包上。

en.t: Tears pattered down onto my school bag.

units.source_text: 脸颊凉飕飕的，只得将书包翻过来。

en.t: My cheek felt chilled, so I had no choice but to turn the bag over.
A boy was sleeping beside me.

units.source_text: 他是河津一家工厂老板的儿子，去东京准备入学考试。

en.t: He was the son of a factory owner in Kawazu and was going to Tokyo to prepare for entrance examinations.

units.source_text: 他看见我头戴一顶大学预科的制帽，对我抱有好感。

en.t: Seeing that I was wearing the cap of a university preparatory school, he took a liking to me.

units.source_text: 我们交谈了几句之后，他说：

en.t: After we had exchanged a few words, he said:
